Great to meet with you both earlier today. Per our discovery, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed, suggested owners, dependencies, and our proposed target close. Quick recap/highlights: 

- Target close: 2026-12-15 (initial estimate; open to shift based on procurement/security cadence)
- Key milestones: Pilot environment ready -> SSO & security review -> Procurement/PO -> Pilot kickoff -> Production rollout
- Dependencies: security questionnaire completion, SSO configuration (IdP metadata), and legal review for SOW

I've assigned tentative owners based on our conversation (column in the attached spreadsheet). Please review the milestones and update owners/dates where needed. Our ask: confirm final owners and any missing dependencies by EOD 2026-11-05 so we can lock the timeline.

Proposed recurring checkpoint: weekly Friday 10:00 AM PT — 15 minute status stand to keep momentum. Let me know if that works.

Attachment: LatticeCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps I’ll take: fold your feedback into v2 and circulate an updated MAP with explicit acceptance checkboxes and a one-page summary for exec visibility.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.
